author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
Joe is back with a new update to his alternating-activation Rank'N'Flank game of fantasy nation building. Added rules for campaigns, expanding your nation and levelling up legendary heroes add some spice to this models-agnostic ruleset. Let's check it out!

Big thanks to Osprey Games for the complimentary copy of the game to review.
